video_title: NBA LEGEND Dame Lillard recorded a track with rap SUPERSTAR Rick Ross

quotes.speaker: Damian Lillard
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard on balancing basketball with life outside the sport
quotes.excerpt: if you just focus on that and all your energy and time is going into it 24/7
quotes.quote: I play NBA 2K, I play basketball for a living, I watch basketball every day. It is such a huge part of my life, but I think if you just focus on that and all your energy and time is going into it 24/7, it can wear you out. You can get burnt out on it, so you have to have something to balance it. Now I have kids and other things that are going to take my time up, but I think something for myself outside of basketball that I am passionate about, something that I am invested in, and I give my time to and I give my energy and effort to, I think it just creates a good balance for me.

quotes.speaker: Damian Lillard
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard on not comparing himself to NBA legends
quotes.excerpt: I never try to compare anything I am a part of to the legends of the game
quotes.quote: I never try to compare anything I am a part of to the legends of the game because I think the times are different. They did what they did and ultimately they paved a way for us to come into the game the way we have. It is a great pairing, and I think it takes time for things to develop and become what everybody wants to see it become on the first day. They want it to be that right away, and I think with me and Giannis Antetokounmpo, he is a strong-minded dude, I am a strong-minded dude. He has played his career a certain way, my career has been a certain way, so I think it takes time for that to come together and for you to figure it out.

quotes.speaker: Damian Lillard
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard on collaborating with Rick Ross on his album
quotes.excerpt: I knew I was going to be on a Rick Ross song because he did a song
quotes.quote: I knew I was going to be on a Rick Ross song because he did a song on my album and all he wanted was for me to do a song to do something with him. He is a mainstream big-time artist, I am an independent artist, so I look at myself as the level of artist I am, not me as an athlete. I ran into him, we did the song for my album and he was just like, I will be in touch with you about something. So I knew it wasn't going to be some setup laid out perfect, I knew it was just going to come when it came and he hit me like, I need you to do this, this the song right here, he sent it to me and the only thing I had to do was just deliver.

quotes.speaker: Damian Lillard
quotes.summary_phrase: Damian Lillard recounts a high school buzzer-beater loss
quotes.excerpt: I get the ball, the clock is running down, I hit a three. We go up by one
quotes.quote: I was 16 years old, my team is playing in a tournament in the Bay Area and we are down by two points. I get the ball, the clock is running down, I hit a three. We go up by one and I am thinking the clock goes to zero. Me and my teammates, we are celebrating, we are all on the court, I take my jersey off, celebrating, I am yelling, I take my jersey off, my coach run on the court like, put your jersey on. My jersey is in my hand, I put my jersey back on and the ref turn and tee me up. Tech, took my jersey off on the court. So I take my jersey off, they give me a tech and in high school, a tech you get two free throws. So we were up one, they make both free throws, we lost the game.
